world_org_meetings.title: Secretary Rubio has a tough time getting officials at G20 on the same page
world_org_meetings.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is hosting the G20 foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta, with a focus on economic and security challenges.

world_org_meetings.title: EU diplomats object to G20 photo with Lavrov, prompting US cancellation
world_org_meetings.description: The meeting in Atlanta will go ahead as planned, ahead of a G20 leaders’ summit hosted by President Donald Trump at his Miami golf club in December.

world_org_meetings.title: G20 'family photo' cancelled after protests over presence of Russian minister
world_org_meetings.description: UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband confronted his Russian counterpart at the meeting and accused his government of killing innocent civilians in Ukraine.

world_org_meetings.title: Russia's presence divides G20 ministers
world_org_meetings.description: The G20 foreign ministers’ meeting in the US is wrapping up two days of talks without agreement on several key global security issues. On the sidelines, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio signed an Arctic cooperation deal with Japan and South Korea and confirmed Washington’s participation in Riyadh’s World Expo in 2030. Meanwhile, European ministers confronted Russia’s Sergei Lavrov over the war in Ukraine and refused to join him for the traditional group photo. Jack Pownall reports.

world_org_meetings.title: EU dropping associate membership title for its closer alliance with Canada
world_org_meetings.description: The words "associate membership" were removed from a joint statement expected to be released at this week's Canada-EU summit, according to a draft seen by CBC News.

diplomatic_visits.title: Senegal hosts first Olympic event on African continent
diplomatic_visits.description: Youth Olympics make history with first African Games in over 130 years, opened by Senegal’s president in Dakar. 136 Senegalese athletes are competing, supported by 6,000 local volunteers.

diplomatic_visits.title: Swiss foreign minister makes first North Korea visit since 2003 as diplomatic office reopens
diplomatic_visits.description: Switzerland is renewing direct talks with North Korea as tensions rise on the peninsula. Seoul hopes the Swiss office will help it engage with Pyongyang.

diplomatic_visits.title: Spain: minute of silence for train crash victims as king visits hospital
diplomatic_visits.description: Spain is mourning 69 people killed in a high-speed train collision near Toledo. As King Felipe VI visits a hospital treating the injured, rescuers continue searching the wreckage and a minute of silence is held at the crash site.

diplomatic_visits.title: King Charles III arrives in Guyana as part of official nine-day Caribbean trip
diplomatic_visits.description: King Charles III has landed in the South American country of Guyana, a former British colony that was the site of one of the biggest slave revolts in the Caribbean during the colonial era

diplomatic_visits.title: UK PM Burnham says 'open' to slavery apology but rules out financial reparations
diplomatic_visits.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Saturday he was "open" to the UK apologising for the first time for its role in the transatlantic slave trade but rejected calls for financial reparations. Issues around Britain's colonial history have loomed large over King Charles' ongoing visit to three Caribbean nations ahead of Commonwealth summit.

elections.title: Judge orders Trump administration to stop threatening US election officials
elections.description: The order comes after election officials received letters demanding they set aside the ballots of possible non-citizen voters.

elections.title: Alaska Senate candidate denies knowing about alleged plot to put two Dan Sullivans on ballot
elections.description: The incumbent Republican running for re-election and allies have accused the Democrats of trying to confuse voters by recruiting a second Dan Sullivan to also stand in the race.

elections.title: Spain train disaster clouds Sánchez chances of re-election
elections.description: The Spanish PM is hit by a succession of crises just weeks before a snap general election.

elections.title: CCTV and zip ties: How US mail-in votes are secured and counted
elections.description: BBC Verify goes to an election centre to get a behind-the-scenes look at how mail-in ballots for the US midterm elections are processed.

elections.title: Democrats have high hopes for midterms, but polls have let them down before
elections.description: Polls have been predicting a Democratic surge, but last-minute deciders and sampling issues mean there's no guarantee.
